physics-killer-01.s.s1.explain: 因为在A点为静止状态，所以由$mgh_A=\frac12mv^2+mgh$得$v=\sqrt{2g(h_A-h)}$。$v_B=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot5}=10$，$v_C=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot20}=20$，$v_D=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot45}=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$。因此$v_C/v_B=2$倍，$v_D=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$。速率并不与下降的高度成正比，而是与$\sqrt{\Delta h}$成正比（错误选项①）；若把D点的高度$5\,\mathrm{m}$误当作下降的高度，则得$10\,\mathrm{m/s}$（错误选项③）；若漏掉$\frac12$，则得$\sqrt{10\cdot45}\approx21\,\mathrm{m/s}$（错误选项④）。
physics-killer-01.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-01.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
physics-killer-01.s.s1.hint.0: 机械能守恒：$mg(h_A-h)=\frac12mv^2$，即$v=\sqrt{2g\,\Delta h}$（$\Delta h$为从A点下降的高度）。
